evidence.title: How we made a text-to-speech model respond in sub-50 ms

summary: A team has developed a text-to-speech AI model capable of responding in under 50 milliseconds, setting a new benchmark for real-time performance. The breakthrough enhances applications requiring instant voice synthesis, such as live translation or interactive assistants.
title: Researchers Achieve Sub-50 Millisecond Response Time in Text-to-Speech AI Model
